references: A 3 × 3 contact sheet of the existing fox portraits, in playbook order: adventurer, arbiter, harrier, ranger, ronin, scoundrel, thief, tinker, vagrant.

jobs.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE original woodland RPG character portrait matching the attached reference sheet's visual language. The sheet is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: output ONE character, never a grid. Same bold irregular black ink contours, sparse scratchy hatching and subtle paper print texture INSIDE flat color shapes, earthy olive/mustard/rust/dusty teal palette. Enormous head about 45% of height, tiny squat body, stumpy legs and pointed boots, simple mitten paws, huge yellow round eyes with black pupils without glossy highlights, angular brows and crooked roguish smirk. Full body centered on square 1024x1024 canvas, entirely visible with 8% transparent padding, all equipment and tail within frame. Transparent background. No text, no frame, no scenery, no shadow backdrop. No realistic fur or scales, no gradients, no 3D, no glossy digital painting. Clothes and equipment use a few large readable shapes, exactly the level of detail in the references.
Subject: a sturdy brown BEAR, broad rounded head, two small round ears, dark chocolate fur, tan broad muzzle, black nose, tiny round tail. Bear anatomy must be clearly recognizable; no pointed ears, no fox tail.
Playbook: adventurer. Outfit and pose: olive tunic, mustard neckerchief, leather belt and one pouch. One paw rests on oversized sheathed short sword at hip, the other holds rolled map. Jaunty confident stance.
